input.overview: Vegas offers two compatible plans: spell V-E-G-A-S through the yellow-lamp features toward Cashier, or build the left loop with the five right drop targets. The bank can raise the loop to 5x, and Multiball doubles playfield scoring, making a lit loop worth up to 10x.
input.simpleOverview: Complete the five right drop targets to raise the left loop toward 5x, then repeat the loop. Multiball doubles scoring. Separately, collect the yellow V-E-G-A-S features to light Cashier.
input.summary: Use the right bank to build the repeatable left loop, then alternate light and collect through that loop; pursue V-E-G-A-S features when their starts are safely available.

quickInfo.name: Raise Loop
quickInfo.summary: Complete the five right drop targets, up to 5x.

quickInfo.name: Score Loop
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the left loop; it alternates between lighting and collecting its award.

quickInfo.name: Double Scoring
quickInfo.summary: Multiball doubles playfield values, including the loop.

quickInfo.name: Cashier
quickInfo.summary: Complete the yellow V-E-G-A-S feature lamps, then shoot the lit Cashier.

steps.text: Complete the five right drop targets to raise the left-loop multiplier toward 5x.
Repeat the left loop, watching its alternating light-and-collect state.
When Multiball is active, prioritize the built left loop because playfield scoring is doubled.
Take safe feature starts to complete the yellow V-E-G-A-S lamps, then shoot the lit Cashier.

alternatives.title: V-E-G-A-S feature route
alternatives.when: Use this when feature starts are safer or the right drop bank is rejecting dangerously.

steps.text: Use Joker and Select-a-Feature awards to fill missing yellow V-E-G-A-S lamps.
Play the lit slot, roulette, and card features according to their visible state.
After V-E-G-A-S is complete, shoot Cashier for the qualified award.
Complete the right five-bank enough times to raise the left loop to 5x.
Repeat the left loop and track whether the next pass lights or collects.

machineSetup: Test the right five-bank and reset, left-loop state lamps, Multiball start and ball release, Joker and Select-a-Feature awards, slot hole, roulette, Cashier, and score rollover display.
Confirm tournament settings, Extra Ball and Special conversion, and whether Double-or-Nothing is enabled.

playfieldReferences.description: Five-target bank that raises the left-loop multiplier.

playfieldReferences.label: Multiplied left loop
playfieldReferences.description: Repeatable shot that alternates between lighting and collecting its award.

playfieldReferences.label: Cashier collect
playfieldReferences.description: Collect shot lit by completing the yellow V-E-G-A-S feature lamps.

cautions.issue: The loop alternates between qualifying and collecting, and the score can roll over.
cautions.response: Read the loop lamp before every shot and track the displayed score digit rather than assuming a missed award or lead.
